subject: Weekly alignment: priorities, OKR checks & QBR action items
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, maya_srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly alignment: priorities, OKR checks & QBR action items

Team —

Quick alignment ahead of the QBR cycle. TL;DR: momentum on Hosted integrations, a performance risk on a key quantized build, and three asks for leadership.

Wins:
- Hosted API adoption: 3 new production integrations this week (two mid-market SaaS, one enterprise). Pipeline motion is showing improved demo-to-POC conversion.
- Cost optimization pilot: initial batching tuning on a mid-tier workload reduced token cost by ~18% in A/B test.

Risks / Blockers:
- Runtime regression in quantized 8-bit path for Llama-variant on Dedicated nodes. Repro rate ~12% on long-context samples; infra + research triaging. Potential QBR talking point if unresolved.
- Procurement delay for additional Dedicated GPUs (purchase order stuck in procurement queue) — could limit capacity for our next burst window.

Asks (concrete):
1) Laura — confirm whether finance can accelerate the PO sign-off by EOD Wed so we can schedule capacity tests next week.
2) Maya & Marissa — prep a one-pager for QBR that shows the quantization regression impact (screenshots, repro steps, current mitigation plan). Attach a draft by Tue COB.
3) Vivek — recommend whether we expose the regression as a degradation in the product dashboard or quietly patch in the next rollout. I lean toward a controlled note with rollback policy.

Attachments: QBR_prep_one_pager.pdf (draft), OKR_weekly_snapshot.xlsx
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBRprep
HubSpot ref: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/ACME-4412

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Sr. Manager, Strategic Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, maya_srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Park <jenna@enterprisecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly alignment: priorities, OKR checks & QBR action items

Thanks, Priyom. Good summary — a couple of notes and an external ask.

On PO sign-off: finance is willing to expedite if we can provide a short business justification and a risk matrix (2 slides). I can push them but need that justification by EOD Tue.

Maya / Marissa — please include estimated delta to SLA if Dedicated capacity is constrained (percent throughput drop, expected queue times).

Vivek — for the communication approach: I agree with a controlled note. Flag the affected model variants and provide a mitigation timeline.

Jenna — looping you in since ACME has signaled a potential ramp next quarter; any tolerance on short capacity dips?
